Initial release: movie & TV research skill powered by Crawlora API.

- Retrieves metadata, cast/crew details, ratings, reviews, streaming availability, and box office numbers for movies and TV shows.
- Integrates data from IMDb, TMDB, JustWatch, Letterboxd, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, and Box Office Mojo.
- Returns normalized JSON responses—no web scraping required.
- Supports lookups for cast, ratings, reviews, streaming options, box-office performance, and recommendations.
- Requires a Crawlora API key for access.
